name: Macro Market Sentiment Monitor
name_zh: 宏观市场情绪监控看板
description: A layered, read-only view of U.S. equity risk appetite, long-duration risk pressure and slower macro leading indicators.
intended_use: Identify whether the market is in a fear, neutral or greed regime
Check whether credit, volatility, breadth or liquidity conditions are deteriorating
Decide when to hold, wait or move into deeper research

indicator_layers.name: Sentiment spectrum
inputs: S&P 500 breadth above the 200-day moving average
S&P 500 momentum versus the 125-day moving average

indicator_layers.name: Long-duration risk overlays
inputs: Net liquidity: Federal Reserve balance sheet minus Treasury General Account minus reverse repo

indicator_layers.name: Macro leading backdrop
inputs: Four-week average of initial unemployment claims

limitations: The dashboard combines indicators with different time horizons and data freshness
Some inputs are maintained manually and may be older than automated sources
The framework is centered on U.S. equities and long-duration risk assets
The composite is not a real-time quote, short-term market-timing model or individualized investment advice
public_artifact: Self-contained static HTML with public JSON snapshots. Browser-delivered interface code and displayed data are inspectable; the private update pipeline is not included.
